name: HermitStash
description: HermitStash is a self-hosted file upload server with post-quantum encryption. Every file and database field is sealed with an ML-KEM-1024 + ECDH P-384 hybrid envelope and XChaCha20-Poly1305 before touching disk; passwords use Argon2id. Nothing is stored in plaintext, including database fields the operator never thinks of as sensitive.
author: dotCooCoo
